blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — First lady Liza Araneta-Marcos has urged global communities to work together to ensure children’s safety online as the world moves toward a more digitally centered future. Marcos made the call in her speech at the Fostering the Future Together (FTFT) event in Pasay City on Monday. The initiative, launched by United States first lady Melania Trump, aims to empower children and youth through education, digital literacy, and the safe use of technology.
